metaDescription: Shop custom 6-11 can outdoor blankets at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for picnics, concerts, and tailgates. Order bulk for your brand today.
introHtml: Custom outdoor blankets designed to hold 6 to 11 cans offer a practical blend of portability and comfort for picnics, concerts, and tailgates. These blankets feature built-in handles, carrying straps, or roll-up designs that make transport easy. With options like the Roll-Up Picnic Blanket or the Sand Repellent Blanket, you can choose materials that resist moisture or sand. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery to create a giveaway that attendees will use all season.
heroAltText: Custom 6-11 can outdoor blanket with rolled design and carrying strap, perfect for picnics and tailgates
